scoring: All three are computed over every document. Distances in the original space are cosine on the stored vectors (float32 widened to float64); distances in the picture are euclidean on the stored coordinates.
recall: the mean over documents of |k nearest in the original space AND k nearest in the picture| / k.
purity: the mean over documents of the share of its k nearest in the picture that have its own label.
k is scoreNeighbours: min(10, ceil(n / 2) - 1), because trustworthiness needs k < n / 2.
Ties are broken by lower index (a stable sort); the stored data has none that matter.
perplexityRule: requested = min(30, max(5, floor((n - 1) / 3))) (the sidecar); openTSNE 1.0.4 uses (n - 1) / 3 instead when 3 * requested > n - 1 (MultiscaleMixture.check_perplexities); neighbours = min(n - 1, int(3 * effective)). The script asserts openTSNE's own warning agrees with this rule for every case.
script: # Makes mods/atlas.map/src/fixtures/tsne-opentsne.json: inputs from a seeded numpy generator, and, for each
# case, what the sidecar's own do_reduce (method "tsne", openTSNE) made of them, plus scikit-learn's scores
# for that picture and for the sidecar's PCA of the same vectors. The Document Map's JavaScript t-SNE is
# judged against these SCORES, never against coordinates (openTSNE's are not reproducible outside it).
import base64, importlib.util, io, json, logging, math, re, sys
def clusters(n, d, k, centre_scale, noise):
# A swiss roll in 3-D carried into d dimensions by a random orthonormal map; labels are the
# position along the roll, so neighbours along the curve share a label.
roll = np.stack([t * np.cos(t), h, t * np.sin(t)], axis=1) / 10.0
rows = roll @ q.T + rng.normal(size=(n, d)) * noise
labels = np.minimum(((t - 1.5 * math.pi) / (3 * math.pi) * bins).astype(int), bins - 1)
# ---- the scores (the JS scorer in quality.ts implements exactly these three) ----
dx = 1.0 - xn @ xn.T                      # cosine distance in the original space
dy = ((y64[:, None, :] - y64[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(-1)   # squared euclidean in the picture
return np.argsort(dx, axis=1, kind="stable"), np.argsort(dy, axis=1, kind="stable")
recall = float(np.mean([len(set(nx[i]) & set(ny[i])) / k for i in range(len(x64))]))
purity = float(np.mean([np.mean(labels[ny[i]] == labels[i]) for i in range(len(x64))]))
# openTSNE 1.0.4 MultiscaleMixture.check_perplexities (affinity.py): when 3p > n-1 the perplexity
# used is (n-1)/3. The sidecar asks for min(30, max(5, (n-1)//3)).
return requested, ((n - 1) / 3 if 3 * requested > n - 1 else float(requested))
# _reduce swallows every exception and answers PCA labelled "pca": a case that fell back would make
assert out["method"] == "tsne", (name, "did not run openTSNE", out["method"])
assert len(said) == 1 and abs(float(said[0]) - effective) < 0.005, (name, said, effective)
assert y.shape == (n, 2) and np.isfinite(y).all() and y.min() >= 0 and y.max() <= 1
k = min(10, math.ceil(n / 2) - 1)        # trustworthiness needs k < n / 2
def clustered(name, note, n, d, k, centre_scale, noise):
v, lab = clusters(n, d, k, centre_scale, noise)
clustered("separated-300x64", "six well-separated clusters; d above 50, so the PCA-50 step is used", 300, 64, 6, 1.0, 0.25),
clustered("overlapping-300x32", "five clusters that overlap: the hard case, purity is not saturated", 300, 32, 5, 0.3, 0.55),
run("curved-300x16", "a swiss roll carried into 16 dimensions: structure that is a curve, not blobs", *curved(300, 16, 6, 0.02)),
clustered("tiny-4x8", "n = 4: perplexity clamp, the smallest real run", 4, 8, 2, 1.0, 0.3),
clustered("wide-150x96", "four clusters in 96 dimensions: the PCA-50 step on a wide input", 150, 96, 4, 1.0, 0.7),
clustered("large-1200x32", "n = 1,200: openTSNE searches neighbours approximately (Annoy) from n = 1,000; clustered and overlapping", 1200, 32, 8, 0.32, 0.5),
"howMade": "python -I -B make-tsne-fixture.py sidecar/pm_sidecar.py out.json, run with the venv of an installed PM "
"(numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, openTSNE; the lock is sidecar/requirements-tsne.lock); the script is the "
"`script` field. The tests compare SCORES, never coordinates.",
"All three are computed over every document. Distances in the original space are cosine on the stored vectors "
"(float32 widened to float64); distances in the picture are euclidean on the stored coordinates.",
"recall: the mean over documents of |k nearest in the original space AND k nearest in the picture| / k.",
"purity: the mean over documents of the share of its k nearest in the picture that have its own label.",
"k is scoreNeighbours: min(10, ceil(n / 2) - 1), because trustworthiness needs k < n / 2.",
"Ties are broken by lower index (a stable sort); the stored data has none that matter.",
"perplexityRule": "requested = min(30, max(5, floor((n - 1) / 3))) (the sidecar); openTSNE 1.0.4 uses (n - 1) / 3 instead when "
"3 * requested > n - 1 (MultiscaleMixture.check_perplexities); neighbours = min(n - 1, int(3 * effective)). "
"The script asserts openTSNE's own warning agrees with this rule for every case.",
{m: {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in s.items()} for m, s in c["scores"].items()})
